name: Ramelteon
description: A selective melatonin MT1 and MT2 receptor agonist approved for sleep-onset insomnia. Not a controlled substance.

systems.note: Melatonin receptor agonism shortening sleep latency; the labelled indication.
Decreased testosterone and increased prolactin are labelled endocrine effects.
Extensive first-pass metabolism; not recommended in severe hepatic impairment.

monitors.why: Extensive first-pass metabolism with a labelled hepatic restriction.
